dct_description_sm: To evaluate the health of the Beaufort Sea beluga whale population by measuring several health indices. The data may provide the foundations for the creation of a long term monitoring plan in the Marine Protected Area (MPA). The program addressed health from the following perspectives: a) the incidence of diseases and parasites with diagnostic testing b) toxicity effects associated with contaminants and c) nutritional condition of beluga as it related to available food quality/quantitiy.
dct_title_s: Community-Based Monitoring of Beluga Health in the Beaufort Sea Region
